notes.body: You dropped the " (short)" from the second arg?

yes, I did. Do we need to state explicitly "short" there? Is there any other protocol says "short"? For me it seemed rather a minor bug, hence removed it.
Do you want me to add it back?
No, I think what you did was right.
yes, that is used a few times and I decided to keep it. `nas-eps` is similar.
Should we add to the "code checking scripts" something that prevents these macros from coming back (especially for "external" dissectors that finally get merged into the repo)?
